data.name: AlHazim
data.gender_notes: AlHazim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hazim' which means wise, intelligent, and prudent. In Islamic tradition, AlHazim is a name for someone who possesses deep understanding and knowledge, and is revered for his wisdom and insight. The name AlHazim carries the meaning “The Wise One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHazim usually hope their child will grow to embody the wise one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: AlHazim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Wise One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHazim total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
